title: Nagymaros Hydroelectric Dam
summary: Hungary's half of the Gabčíkovo–Nagymaros barrage system on the Danube was abandoned in 1989 under mass environmental pressure and suspended by parliament, making it one of the first major infrastructure rollbacks in late-socialist Europe. The dispute with Czechoslovakia (later Slovakia) reached the International Court of Justice in 1997, which ruled Hungary had acted unlawfully but could not compel construction. The Nagymaros site remains unbuilt.
